desc: Parse N and S from stdin, extract 0-indexed positions of all '1' characters into list p.
Compute q[j] = p[j] - j for j in 0..k-1 (normalizes so a contiguous block corresponds to all q values equal).
Find the median of q (q is non-decreasing since p is strictly increasing, so median = q[k//2], no sort needed).
Compute answer = sum |q[j] - median| and print it.
Write the complete Python solution: read N and S from stdin, collect 0-indexed positions of '1's, compute q[j] = p[j] - j, take median m = q[k//2], output sum |q[j] - m|.
